login.tagline: Everything you own, and where it is.
login.notConfigured: No sign-in method is configured. Set OIDC_ISSUER on the server.
login.footer: Password-less sign-in via your identity provider.

home.title: Things
home.emptyBody: Start with the places things are in: your home, its rooms, shelves and boxes. Or just add a thing and put it somewhere later.

reminders.title: Reminders
reminders.description: Get a message when maintenance is due, at ntfy, Gotify, Discord, Telegram, email and other services.
reminders.urlsHint: One Shoutrrr URL per line, e.g. ntfy://ntfy.sh/your-topic.
reminders.urlsHintHosts: One Shoutrrr URL per line. Self-hosted services must be on: {{hosts}}.
reminders.daysHint: e.g. 7, 0: a week before and on the day.

paperless.description: Link manuals and receipts from your Paperless at {{url}}.
paperless.tokenSaved: A token is saved. Enter a new one to replace it.
paperless.serverToken: As an admin you use the server’s token unless you save your own.
paperless.tokenHint: Find it in Paperless under your profile.
paperless.backlinksHint: Documents you link get a link to their things in the “{{field}}” custom field. Your token must be allowed to change documents.

fields.title: Custom fields
fields.description: Extra details every thing can have, such as price, purchase date or warranty until.

import.title: Import from HomeBox
import.description: Copy every location, item, tag, custom field, photo, document and maintenance entry from HomeBox. Asset IDs become label codes, so printed labels keep working. Importing again skips what’s already here.
import.tokenHint: Make one in HomeBox under Profile. It isn’t saved.
import.counts: {{things}} things, {{photos}} photos, {{documents}} documents, {{maintenance}} maintenance entries; {{skipped}} already here

tokens.title: API tokens
tokens.description: Let other apps, such as Warranteed, use Wherehouse as you. Tokens can’t do what only admins can.
tokens.copyNow: Copy the token now. It won’t be shown again.

household.title: Household
household.description: Everyone in the household sees and changes all of its places and things.
household.name: Name
household.inviteHint: Anyone who can sign in here and opens this link within 7 days joins the household.

kinds.title: Kinds
kinds.description: What things can be. Places are shown as cards and offered when you put something somewhere; any thing can hold others.

templates.title: Templates
templates.description: Things to start new ones from, with their kind, details, price, tags and photos. Save one from a thing’s menu.

export.title: Export
export.description: Take your data with you, or keep a copy.
export.hint: The ZIP has every detail of every thing with its photos and documents; documents in Paperless stay there.

errors.offline: Can't reach the server. Check your connection.

server.uploadTooLarge: Files can be at most {{mb}} MB
server.nameLong: Names can be at most {{max}} characters
server.textLong: Texts can be at most {{max}} characters
server.quantity: Quantity must be a whole number from 1 to {{max}}
server.parentMissing: The place to put it in doesn’t exist any more
server.parentInside: A place can’t go inside itself or a place inside it
server.labelCount: Make 1 to {{max}} labels at a time
server.labelUsed: That label is already on something else
server.notifyNeedsUrl: Add at least one notification URL first
server.notifyHostNotAllowed: “{{host}}” isn't an allowed notification host — allowed: {{allowed}}
server.paperlessNotConfigured: Paperless is not configured — set it up in Settings
server.fieldLong: Field names can be at most {{max}} characters
server.reminderDays: Reminder days: “{{value}}” is not a valid number of days
server.paperlessNotSetUp: Paperless isn't set up on this server — ask an admin
server.paperlessGone: This document no longer exists in Paperless
server.fieldMissing: That field doesn’t exist any more
server.testBody: Notifications are working. You’ll be reminded when maintenance is due.
server.notifyNeedsAdmin: {{scheme}} notifications need an admin to allow the host (WHEREHOUSE_NOTIFY_ALLOWED_HOSTS); Discord, Telegram, Slack, Pushover, Pushbullet, IFTTT and Join always work
server.tagLong: Tags can be at most {{max}} characters
server.maintenanceTitle: Say what was done or is to be done
server.alreadyLinked: That document is already on this thing
server.maintenanceWhen: Give the date it was done, when it’s due, or both
server.fieldExists: There’s already a field with that name
server.homeboxUrl: The HomeBox address must start with http:// or https://
server.tokenName: Give the token a name, e.g. the app that uses it
server.linkUrl: Links must be web addresses starting with http:// or https://
server.ownerOnly: Only the household’s owners can do that
server.inviteGone: This invite link has expired or doesn’t exist
server.iconTooLarge: Icons can be at most {{kb}} KB
server.iconType: Icons must be SVG, PNG, WebP or JPEG images
server.currency: Currency must be a 3-letter code, e.g. EUR
server.lastOwner: Make someone else an owner first
server.kindNeeded: This kind is what new things are and can’t be deleted
server.iconUsed: A kind still uses this icon
server.kindMissing: That kind doesn’t exist any more
server.thingNotEmpty: Move or delete what’s inside first
server.appSource: An app’s name must be lowercase letters, digits and dashes
server.appExternalId: Say what the link is to in the app
server.appDataLong: An app’s data can be at most {{kb}} KB
server.connectCode: This code has expired or was used already
server.hookTokenOnly: Only an app’s token can set where to ping it
server.hookNotConnected: Only apps connected through Connect can be pinged
server.hookHost: Pings can only go to {{host}}, the address approved when connecting

signIn.unreachable: Could not reach the identity provider. Try again in a moment.
signIn.expired: Your sign-in attempt expired. Please try again.
signIn.state: Sign-in state did not match. Please try again.
signIn.exchange: Could not reach the identity provider.
signIn.rejected: The identity provider rejected the sign-in. Check the client ID, secret and callback URL.
signIn.noIdToken: The identity provider did not return an ID token.
signIn.verify: Could not verify the identity token.
signIn.notAllowed: Your account is not allowed to use this app.

place.emptyBody: Nothing here yet. Add things, or places inside this one, like shelves or boxes.

item.archivedToast: Archived. It’s hidden from places and lists.
item.deleteBody: The thing and its photos are deleted. To keep a record of it, archive it instead.

items.unplacedBody: Things added without a place. Drag them onto a place, or open one and move it.
items.archivedBody: Things you got rid of but want to remember.

picker.noPlaces: No places yet. Type a name to add one.

search.label: Search
search.title: “{{q}}”
search.noResults: Nothing found. Try fewer or shorter words.

label.title: Label for “{{name}}”
label.queuedMany_one: {{count}} label added to the print list
label.queuedMany_other: {{count}} labels added to the print list
label.scanHint: Scan it with a phone camera to open this page.
label.none: No label yet. Make one to print, or use a label you printed earlier.

labels.title: Labels
labels.description: Print QR labels for boxes, shelves and things. Scanning one opens its page.
labels.skipHint: Already used on the first sheet.
labels.empty: Nothing to print. Open a place or thing and choose Label, or add blank labels below.
labels.blankHint: Stick them on and scan them to say what they’re on.

scan.title: Scan a label
scan.noCamera: The camera isn’t available. Allow it in the browser, or type the code below.
scan.hint: Point the camera at a label’s QR code. A phone’s own camera app opens labels too.

labelPage.unknown: This label isn’t known here yet. Put it on a place, or on a new thing.
labelPage.blank: This label isn’t on anything yet. Put it on a place, or on a new thing.
labelPage.newThing: Put it on a new thing
labelPage.onThingHint: For a thing you already have, open it and choose Label.
labelPage.otherHousehold: This label is of “{{name}}”, another of your households.

tags.name: Name
tags.mergeHint: Giving it another tag’s name merges the two.
tags.deleteBody: The tag is taken off every thing. The things stay.

maintenance.title: Maintenance
maintenance.none: Nothing logged. Add services, repairs, and what is due next.

links.title: Links
links.none: No links. Add the shop’s page, a video, or its warranty in Warranteed.

thing.templateSaved: Saved as a template. Pick it when adding a thing.

thingForm.name: Name
thingForm.placePlaceholder: e.g. Kitchen, Garage shelf, Box of cables
thingForm.ownedBy: The purchase and warranty are kept in {{app}}; change them there.

icons.title: Icon
icons.uploadHint: One-colour SVG or PNG icons look best; they take the colour of the text.

households.title: Households
households.addHint: A separate set of places and things, such as a cottage or your parents’ home. Invite others to it from Settings.

join.title: Join “{{name}}”
join.body_one: {{count}} person is in it. You’ll see and share everything in it.
join.body_other: {{count}} people are in it. You’ll see and share everything in it.

report.title: Value
report.description: What your things cost, from their purchase prices. Sold and archived things don’t count.
report.noInsured: Nothing is marked as insured. Mark things as insured when you edit them.

connect.title: Connect {{app}}
connect.body: {{app}} at {{host}} wants to use Wherehouse as you: see and change the things of the household you pick.
connect.hint: You can disconnect it any time by deleting its token in Settings → API tokens.

document.title: Paperless document {{id}}
document.none: This document isn’t on anything here.
